Name: Scout
Description: An early-action specialist who seizes the opening of battle with scouted abilities that can only be used as the first action of a wave, then transform into a lesser related ability afterward. He builds aim quickly, attacks enemies at full health for bonus damage, and is difficult to eliminate before he gets to act.
Weapon Mech: initiative bonus, acts sooner in first round
Major 1: Adroit Momentum – Ranged attack with pinpoint and momentum enhancing accuracy
Major 2: Aimed Momentum – Ranged attack that generates extra aim based on momentum
Major 3: Coordinated Shot – Ranged attack with quick preparation that grants increased accuracy and damage to next attack versus target
Major 4: Delaying Jolt – Ranged attack with delay against stunned target
Major 5: Flanking Shot – Ranged attack that causes flanked
Major 6: Lay of the Land – Ranged attack that enhances dodge of team based on aim
Major 7: Quickening Aim – Ranged attack against single target that consumes aim to quicken self
Major 8: Rapid Vow – Prepared ranged attack that determines target on preparation.  Quickens scout on preparation and on use
Major 9: Scouted Arrow Burst – Ranged attack against all enemies.  Deals less damage and requires aim if not first turn
Major 10: Scouted Chink – Full penetration ranged attack if first attack of battle.  Can proc full penetration with ranged attack after
Major 11: Scouted Shot – Ranged attack with momentum.  Generates aim if first turn
Major 12: Speed Shot – Ranged attack that requires momentum and grants aim and deals extra damage based on momentum
Major 13: Sudden Shot – Ranged attack with sudden
Major 14: Supplemented Shot – Ranged attack.  Causes the target to take damage on the next x times it misses.  Consumes aim
Move 1: Aimed Pursuit – Follows hit, quickens ally and enhances accuracy based on aim on target
Move 2: Danger Warning – Grants all allies enhanced dodge until next turn
Move 3: Momentum Arrow – Ranged attack requiring momentum
Move 4: Scouted Positions – Flanks and delays all enemies as first action.  Otherwise flanks and delays single enemy
Move 5: Scouted Preparations – Provides initial bonuses as a period enhancement to all allies on first turn.  Otherwise only provides them until next turn
Move 6: Speed Screen – Grants haste until next turn and generates aim, must be used as last action
Minor 1: Momentous Initiative – Gain initial bonuses until beginning of next turn.  Requires momentum
Minor 2: Perilous Ground – Follows ranged attack, flanks target
Minor 3: Scouted Aim – Alpha, generates aim.  Also enhances accuracy and quickens self as first action
Minor 4: Scouted Maneuvers - Quicken all and remove flanked as first action.  Otherwise only quickens and removes flanked from a single target
Minor 5: Share Momentum – Quicken all allies based on momentum
Capstone Skill: New Beginning (Momentum Modifier) – If momentum is high enough, gain initial bonuses on turn, including ability to use scouted abilities.

Name: Huntsman
Description: A distance fighter who uses momentum to enhance his arrows and can penetrate armor more effectively the further away his target is. He tracks a specific enemy type, gaining bonuses against others of the same kind as his primary aim target and hitting harder the longer he sustains focus.
Weapon Mech: bonus scales with number of enemies of the hunted type present
Capstone Skill: Bane Targeting – The modified skill has a chance to target all enemies of the same type.

Name: Crossbowman
Description: A heavy crossbow specialist who attacks more slowly than other archers but deals more damage per shot with greater penetration. He is more defensive than most archer subclasses, reacting to enemy attacks against him rather than purely pressing offense, and can fortify and reload quickly between shots.
Weapon Mech: very high damage, very long reload
Capstone Skill: Instant Reload – The Crossbowman has a chance to reload after any ranged attack.

Name: Marksman
Description: An accuracy and penetration specialist who places marks on enemies that grant his allies benefits when they attack the same targets. He is the team's force multiplier at range, making his aim target more dangerous for everyone and sharing his exceptional accuracy with those who follow his lead.
Capstone Skill: Unerring Marks – After the Marksman attacks a target, all attacks against the target are unerring for a number of times.

Name: Falconer
Description: A companion-focused archer whose pet falcon harries targets and enables abilities that either work better in the falcon's presence or require it outright. He uses the falcon to set up aim, distract enemies, and coordinate strikes — making his companion an active offensive asset rather than a passive attendant.
Capstone Skill: Flying Falcon – Falcon can only be targeted by ranged attacks and has increased dodge.

Name: Bounty Hunter
Description: A capture-specialist who places bounty afflictions on enemies as minor actions during combat, with those bounties triggering beneficial effects when the marked enemy dies. He can stun and incapacitate targets to take them alive, gaining increasing payoffs the more bounties he has active when enemies fall.
Capstone Skill: Shared Bounty – Bounty abilities affect the entire team when they trigger.

Name: Stalker
Description: A shadow-fighter who generates aim from hidden status and converts high accuracy into higher damage, with a defining ability that expends all accumulated aim for a devastating single attack — but then prevents him from targeting that specific enemy for a period scaled to the aim spent.
Weapon Mech: accuracy bonus scaling with target's lost health

Name: Poacher
Description: A kill-opportunist who triggers immediate prepared attacks the moment an enemy becomes endangered, without those poach abilities being interruptible by damage. He gains culling abilities, preferences for specific target types, and benefits from kills — a specialist at finishing weakened prey faster than anyone else can reach them.

Name: Sharpshooter
Description: A trick-shot specialist whose accuracy-dependent abilities pierce through targets to hit columns behind them and have reduced hit chance but significant effects when they connect. His trick shot success rate scales with current aim relative to maximum aim, rewarding sustained focus on a single target before committing to the high-risk high-reward shots.
Weapon Mech: damage bonus scaling with target's dodge value

Name: Toxophilite
Description: A distance-and-duration specialist who builds power over the course of a long battle through eternal buff abilities that grow without limit but become progressively more expensive to enhance. Only one can be active at a time, demanding that the player commit to a single compounding effect and protect the Toxophilite long enough for it to pay off.

Name: Initiate
Description: A patient striker who builds power by holding his form and releases it explosively on transition. His unleash mechanic rewards stillness — the longer he stays in a single form, the more devastating the eventual change. He has no form preference, making him the most flexible of the monk subclasses and a strong foundation for learning the chakra system.
Weapon Mech: dodge bonus after attacking, duration scales with attack speed
Capstone Skill: Tempered Resolve — Whenever the Initiate resists a percentage damage or death effect, his next attack gains increased damage.

Name: Pugilist
Description: A relentless single-target brawler who punishes the same enemy turn after turn through his impact mechanic. Any enemy he struck last turn becomes the target of a suite of specialized follow-up attacks covering damage, delay, disruption, and control. Lower chakra focused and strength-enhanced, he hits harder the longer he stays locked onto one target.
Weapon Mech: increased damage when attacking same enemy as previous turn
Capstone Skill: Impact Power – The Pugilist deals increased damage if he struck the same target the turn before.

Name: Skirmisher
Description: A fast, opportunistic fighter who mirrors his enemies' own strengths against them through the matching mechanic. He can temporarily adopt a target's critical stats, damage, accuracy, defense, or dodge — turning powerful enemies into their own worst nightmare. Leopard form focused and haste-driven, he excels at demolishing stunned foes and stacking bleeds through repeated Leopard Claw cycles.
Weapon Mech: gains percentage of target's base damage on attack
Capstone Skill: Stunning Roars — Any enemy that is stunned at the beginning of the Skirmisher's turn has their stun duration extended based on level.

Name: Vajra
Description: An immovable reactive combatant who weaponizes his chakra configuration to punish every enemy attack. Snake's Response reflects conditions back at attackers based on which chakras are open, with the lower chakras delivering the most devastating punishments — prone, delay, and disarm simultaneously at full configuration. He fights best when pristine, baiting attacks while armed with Reversal, Absorbed Counter, and a full suite of prepared reactions.
Weapon Mech: chance to stun on reaction and counter attacks
Capstone Skill: Diamond Body — If the Vajra does not target an enemy during his turn, he has a chance to ignore all damage until his next turn.

Name: Stonefist
Description: A fortified earth specialist who turns glancing blows from a weakness into a weapon. His attacks deliberately seek glancing hits to trigger stuns, bleeds, delays, and fragility — and his Pressure Crack capstone extends this to critical hits as well. Tiger form focused and endurance-heavy, he is nearly immovable under sustained assault and punishes enemies for every attempt to pierce his defenses.
Capstone Skill: Pressure Crack — When the Stone Fist scores a critical hit, it also triggers any glancing hit effects on that attack.

Name: Infiltrator
Description: A burst-damage specialist who cycles through hidden states to deliver devastating arrival attacks. Each time he loses hidden — whether by choice or enemy action — he unleashes a different arrival ability covering area damage, flanking, stunning, or penetrating strikes. Mantis focused and initiative-driven, his Exposed Momentum capstone ensures every exposure accelerates his next turn.
Weapon Mech: enhanced critical chance immediately after losing hidden status
Capstone Skill: Exposed Momentum — Whenever the Infiltrator loses hidden, he is quickened.

Name: Viper Fang
Description: A poison-crafting snake form specialist who generates unique toxins from his own body and bleeds. He creates poisons based on his current form through Venom Chakra, conserves and refreshes them through careful resource management, and delivers them through venomous, insidious, and backbiting strikes. Earth and dark elemental focused, he excels at sustained damage over time and attrition warfare.
Weapon Mech: poison applies even on glancing hits
Capstone Skill: Poisonous Refreshment – Whenever the associated proc triggers, the Viper Fang gains a poison use.

Name: Ascetic
Description: A disciplined dragon form purist who draws power from maintaining a state of perfect purity. His most powerful abilities — Fist of Purity, Double Purity, Whirlwind Purity — require being completely unafflicted, while his Condition Fortress capstone makes him progressively harder to afflict as conditions accumulate. He manages corruption, stuns enemies with dragon-powered strikes, and uses focus as both a resource and a defensive tool.
Capstone Skill: Condition Fortress — The Ascetic gains increased affliction resistance for each condition currently affecting him, whether affliction or enchantment.

Name: Thunderfist
Description: A chain-combat specialist who builds devastating sequences of air, stun, and shatter effects through careful ability ordering. Nearly every move and minor ability has a trigger condition — following a counter, a critical, a shatter, or an air attack — creating dense combo potential that rewards mechanical knowledge. Crane focused and counter-driven, his Thunder Strikes capstone ensures every stunned enemy takes bonus air damage on each hit.
Weapon Mech: delayed secondary damage add after initial attack
Capstone Skill: Thunder Strikes — Whenever the Thunderfist attacks a stunned enemy, that enemy also takes air damage.

Name: Drunken Master
Description: A chaotic form-shifting brawler who embraces randomness and prone states as sources of power rather than liability. He shifts forms rapidly to build Fluid Punch damage, reach Ultimate Punch thresholds, and trigger Chakra Ascension — while deliberately falling prone to counter from the ground and punish enemies with Misplaced Retribution. His unpredictability is his greatest defense, with low accuracy offset by high dodge and a tendency to accidentally hit exactly the wrong person at exactly the right time.
Weapon Mech: dodge bonus on miss, scales with miss amount
Capstone Skill: Counter from the Ground – The Drunken Master can counter even if prone or disarmed.  Higher levels increase chance to counter.

Name: Bandit
Description: A quick ranged harasser who opens battle at a distance before pivoting to a more dangerous close-quarters fighter when his allies fall. He carries desperation abilities that only activate when he stands alone, rewarding survival over coordinated play.
Capstone Skill: Extended Ambush – Ambush abilities can be used while target has over a percentage of life.

Name: Cutthroat
Description: A dualwield melee brawler who stacks bleed on enemies through relentless two-weapon exchanges and can grant himself intangibility to press the offense without interruption. His advantage generation rewards staying in the fight and bleeding targets dry.
Capstone Skill: Stacking Bleed Proc – The modified skill has a chance to afflict the target with a stacking bleed.

Name: Burglar
Description: An ambush specialist who hits hardest against undamaged enemies and strips buffs from those who have fought back. He can artificially recreate full-health windows late in battle by corrupting enemy maximum health, keeping his ambush toolkit relevant throughout.
Weapon Mech: extra damage against full health enemies
Capstone Skill: Trap Disarmament – Whenever the Burglar would otherwise trigger a trap on the field, they have a chance to remove that trap completely.

Name: Thief
Description: A self-sufficient dualwield fighter who steals accuracy, speed, and senses from enemies to empower himself. He can briefly share his incoming healing and mana gain with allies, giving a team-oriented edge to an otherwise personal playstyle.
Capstone Skill: Grand Larceny — Steal abilities have a chance to trigger a free attack (uses tag system)

Name: Acrobat
Description: A dodge-focused rebuild Rogue who invites attacks, turns misses into advantage, and uses reliable abilities that refund their costs on failure. He thrives in the open and under illumination, unlike most Rogues who prefer the shadows.
Weapon Mech: increased accuracy to next attack after missing, scales with miss amount
Capstone Skill: Glancing Dodge – Whenever the Acrobat suffers a glancing hit, it has a chance to be considered a dodge based on this skill.

Name: Assassin
Description: A single-target executioner who signs contracts against chosen enemies, gaining combat bonuses while pursuing them and earning powerful fulfillment rewards when he personally lands the killing blow. Five contract types let the player tailor each hunt to the situation.
Weapon Mech: chance for instant death to overwhelm resistance
Capstone Skill: Transfer Contract — Next attack after a contract ends applies that contract to the new target

Name: Brigand
Description: A ranged gambler who wagers advantage and mana on battlefield conditions, collecting larger payoffs when those conditions are met. A good run leaves him flush; a bad one leaves him empty, making risk tolerance the central skill of his playstyle.
Weapon Mech: critical damage increases on failed critical
Capstone Skill: Double Down — Enemies have a chance not to lose flanked at the start of their turn

Name: Smuggler
Description: A team-oriented Rogue whose power scales with how many allies are hidden alongside him. He can blanket the party in shadow, share his poisons across the team, and coordinate hidden allies into a unified striking force.
Capstone Skill: Smuggled Poisons - The first poison gained by the smuggler is also shared with all allies.  The amount of uses is based on this skill.

Name: Skulk
Description: A defensively self-reliant Rogue who applies aversion to make enemies ignore him, then punishes them for it. He complements aversion with scorn to layer targeting protection, generating advantage steadily from the safety of being overlooked.
Capstone Skill: Aversion Backstab – Whenever an enemy averted by the skulk attacks, the skulk attacks it in response.

Name: Ninja
Description: A hidden-mastery specialist who chains haste, advantage, and free bonus attacks by maintaining concealment across multiple actions. He rewards players who have mastered the hidden economy, with insidious attacks and precise sequencing separating competent play from exceptional play.
Capstone Skill: Second Poison — The Ninja can apply a second poison simultaneously

Name: Scavenger
Description: A chaotic support-attacker who thrives on unpredictability. Her scavenged abilities reveal their element on preparation rather than use, making her toolkit flexible but harder to plan around. She generates ammo from kills and builds belts from whatever she has on hand — a scrappy, resource-efficient subclass that rewards improvisation.
Weapon Mech: damage and ammo load based on mana, mana ammo

Name: Alchemist
Description: A prepared-resource specialist who enters battle with concoctions already brewed and ready to use without cost or preparation. She leans into healing, poison, and resurrection, and her premade system lets her open waves with full-power abilities immediately. Her capstone Premade Reserves deepens this advantage, making her the Teknixian most oriented toward sustained party management.
Capstone Skill: Premade Reserves – Premade abilities have a chance to have multiple uses at the beginning of battle.

Name: Artificer
Description: A trap-setter and accumulator who builds up power before releasing it. Her accumulation abilities charge on first use and discharge on second, rewarding patience with amplified outputs. She also controls the detonation chain — recovering, redirecting, and shielding through it — and provides elemental shields to allies via Teknos Shielding.

Name: Tinker
Description: A modification-based companion commander who toggles different behavioral modes to reshape her companion and her own attacks. Her four modular abilities — Modular Bomb, Modular Ray, Modular Trap, and Modular Beam — each change behavior based on which modifications are active. Flame Spewer and Lightning Tosser are ammo-sensitive companions that change element and effect based on what's loaded at summoning.
Capstone Skill: True Chaos – Chaos abilities both use a random elemental power and target a random elemental resistance.

Name: Engineer
Description: An ally-empowerment specialist who assigns persistent assistant enchantments to party members. Each assistant type triggers a different proc when the assigned ally attacks — shields, heals, traps, bonus attacks, or quickening — and Activate Assistant can fire all procs simultaneously. She also fields the Shield Guardian, a fixed-behavior healing companion with no ammo interaction, and Minefield Assistant turns any attacker into a trap-seeding machine.

Name: Bomber
Description: A high-risk area damage dealer whose bomb abilities hit allies and enemies identically with no discount. She layers countdowns on enemies and manages the self-threat they create using Accept Explosion, Accept Mass Explosion, Gift Bomb, and Transfer Countdown. Explosion Imminent and Kinetic Protection let her mitigate her own friendly fire. The higher the aim output, the harder the landing.
Weapon Mech: fires random amount of ammo per shot, flechette ammo

Name: Gunslinger
Description: A pure ranged damage dealer built around called shots and burst ammo expenditure. Called shots are prepared as a minor action, name a target, and add powerful debuff effects — disarm, stun, heartstrike, slow, or delay — to the first attack used against that target on the following turn. Full Clip and Oblivion Shot are her all-in damage options. High Noon and Showdown both guarantee a counter-attack against her, rewarding Take Cover setups.
Weapon Mech: dual ranged, light damage add, light ammo
Capstone Skill: Quick Call – Called shots can be activated the same turn they are used.

Name: Savant
Description: A slow-burn debuff-accumulator whose six concoctions apply ongoing effects while building power each clock tick, then discharge a scaled effect when the chain fires or time runs out. More ammo at placement extends the window and increases accumulated power at detonation. A Faraday sub-theme lets her wear lightning rod deliberately and redirect incoming storm damage offensively through Faraday Connection's pain link.
Weapon Mech: mana gain on attack, water ammo

Name: Machinist
Description: A companion-amplifier who fields extremely slow, powerful siege engine companions — Ballista, Battering Ram, and Catapult — and spends her own actions making them fire more frequently. Every move and minor ability in her kit serves the companion: Operate Siege Engine quickens it directly, Teamwork Operation converts party delay into companion clock advancement, and Siege Command upgrades whatever the companion would do next. Her own attacks like Amplifying Cannonshot and Earth Cannon give her meaningful damage when she steps away from the engine.
Weapon Mech: chance for area damage, fire ammo

Name: Reliquarian
Description: A relic-stacking power escalator who activates multi-ability relics that grow stronger with each ammo devotion. Each devoted ammo type is locked until the relic ends — which it cannot be cancelled until max devotion — creating deep commitment costs in exchange for battlefield-wide buffs, persistent damage, companion power, or trap generation. Relic Blast and Relic Bolt scale with total ammo devoted across all active relics, making a fully stacked Reliquarian increasingly devastating the longer a wave goes on.

Name: Brute
Description: The patient tank of the Barbarian family. A slower, higher-endurance variant who defers self-damage costs to the next turn through Consequences, generating Anguish immediately while controlling when the pain lands — or redirecting it to enemies entirely with Share Consequence.
Capstone Skill: Ignore Consequences – Whenever the brute would suffer consequences at the beginning of her turn due to a consequences ability, she has a chance to ignore those consequences.

Name: Raider
Description: A shield-and-weapon fighter who builds active defenses only to spend them all at once. Reckless abilities consume all block, dodge, and counter values for amplified attacks, rewarding players who time the exposed window around a supporting tank or use it as a finisher when consequences can't resolve.
Weapon Mech: damage on block or enhanced retaliation
Capstone Skill: Reckless Attack – Attacks from the Raider have a chance to deal increased damage at the cost of preventing any active defenses until next turn.

Name: Berserker
Description: The chaos amplifier of the family, built around Exertion abilities that generate Anguish from repeated misses and spread destruction through Contagious Temper. She leans fully into the Berserk condition, turning random targeting from a liability into an engine, with the Panic pair offering a rare moment of choice between embracing or escaping the disorder.
Capstone Skill: Double Exertion – Exertion effects trigger twice.

Name: Marauder
Description: A dual-wield closer who grows faster and hits harder the more enemies die. Rampage scales with kills — personal kills more than team kills — making bloodlust and counter abilities the tools that keep her offense rolling between turns and feeding the escalation she depends on.
Weapon Mech: rampage bonus scaling with enemy deaths
Capstone Skill: Initial Rampage – The Marauder begins battle with a value of rampage based on this skill.

Name: Viking
Description: A deliberate shield fighter who charges prepared abilities through sustained blocking. Each block adds power to any held ability, and multiple prepared abilities charge independently, rewarding patient setup and precise release timing over the Raider's impulsive spending.

Name: Vandal
Description: Pure escalating output. She accumulates damage dealt toward a threshold that briefly unlocks Brink abilities — powerful options that vanish if not taken — and can sustain Endless Wrath longer than any other subclass before the drain finally overtakes her.
Capstone Skill: Close to the Edge – Attacks the Rager make generate more threshold towards her Brink abilities

Name: Fury
Description: Precise and fast, with a discipline that belies her name. Purity abilities amplify with each use but cancel on specific failure conditions, demanding focused play to maintain multiple stacks simultaneously. She grows faster as she takes damage and reaches peak power when Wrath and Berserk combine.
Capstone Skill: Bloody Berserk – Attack the Rager makes while berserk also have backbiting based on the level of this skill.

Name: Cannibal
Description: A self-sustaining predator who stays hurt to stay fed. Her healing threshold mechanic unlocks powerful abilities as applicable healing accumulates, rewarding healers who time large heals over constant top-offs, while life drain and kill-reaction heals give her independence when the support is occupied elsewhere.
Weapon Mech: damages self at start of turn for stat bonus
Capstone Skill: Vampiric Devotion – Life drain effects are not affected by vitality, but healing has a greater drain on vitality.

Name: Destroyer
Description: The armor-stripping heavyweight, built to cross the massive damage threshold and trigger cascading effects that tear down enemy defenses for the whole team. Destruction Wrath amplifies weakness power and defense reduction, but ends in forsaken and strips all enchantments — making dedicated buffers a liability rather than an asset.
Capstone Skill: Massive Power – The threshold for triggering massive damage is lowered for the Destroyer.

Name: Beastlord
Description: The apex predator and most complex of the Barbarian subclasses. She cycles between four exclusive beast forms, scales overkill into team-wide debuffs, and generates Anguish from damage dealt to any ally — turning chaotic encounters into fuel. Final Wrath guarantees her death when it ends, making every use of it the last decision she makes.
Capstone Skill: Reactive Beast Form – The Beastlord has a chance to gain a beast form whenever damaged.

Name: Gladiator
Description: A flashy, risk-taking fighter who uses gambit abilities that either succeed spectacularly or backfire against her. Critical Stance generates expertise on critical hits, and her gambits deal high damage or critical effects at a cost — such as becoming prone on a miss or inviting counter attacks — rewarding aggressive play with chain weapons.
Major 1: All-in Strike – Melee attack with high damage, high critical damage, and low accuracy.  Gladiator becomes prone on miss (Gladiator)
Major 2: Deflection Gambit – High damage, low accuracy melee attack that randomly attacks another target, enemy or ally, on miss.  Requires expertise (Gladiator)
Major 3: Disarming Gambit – Melee attack with disarm, but gladiator becomes disarmed if this fails (Gladiator)
Major 4: Exciting Exchange – Melee attack that cannot be parried but is always countered (Gladiator)
Major 5: Onslaught Gambit – Melee attack against each enemy with reduced accuracy, but enemies counter gladiator on each miss (Gladiator)
Major 6: Precise Strike, Greater – Melee attack with increased accuracy and critical chance, but delays gladiator (Gladiator)
Major 7: Risky Positioning – Melee attack with blessed accuracy and damage, but causes the gladiator to be flanked (Gladiator)
Major 8: Shattering Sequence – Two shattering melee attacks against a single target consuming expertise (Gladiator)
Major 9: Stunning Gambit – Melee attack that stuns target.  Higher chance to be countered and gladiator becomes stunned if countered (Gladiator)
Major 10: Unremitting Slash – Attack that stays prepared if it misses, lower accuracy (Gladiator)
Major 11: Wild Hope – Melee attack with low accuracy that heals self on hit and damages self on miss (Gladiator)
Major 12: Wound Striker – Melee attack against target wounded enemy (Gladiator)
Move 1: Claim Glory – Prepared reaction to any enemy using a compel or provoke ability.  Melee attack against enemy (Gladiator)
Move 2: Counter Gambit – Guaranteed counter against next attack, but next attack is a critical hit versus the Gladiator (Gladiator)
Move 3: Face the Coward – Purges all allies and field of aversion and scorn effects. (Gladiator)
Move 4: Fist Stratagem – Spend expertise when next attacked to guarantee counter (Gladiator)
Move 5: Parry Stun – Follows parrying since last turn.  Stuns target that was parried (Gladiator)
Move 6: Rip Armor – Lower defense of target stunned enemy (Gladiator)
Move 7: Sand in the Eyes – Blinds the target (Gladiator)
Minor 1: Critical Expertise – Generate expertise following a critical (Gladiator)
Minor 2: Critical Stance – Enhances critical chance, gladiator generates expertise when she criticals (Gladiator)
Minor 3: Intimidation Gambit – Either stuns all enemies or ends turn of gladiator, alpha (Gladiator)
Minor 4: Prepared Correction – Gladiator reattempts the next attack that misses.  Prepared and consumes expertise (Gladiator)
Minor 5: Reaping Gambit – Next attack deals reaping damage.  On miss, it also deals reaping damage to Gladiator (Gladiator)
Minor 6: Turn to Enemy – Purges Gladiator of aversion (Gladiator)
Capstone Skill: High Stakes – Whenever the Gladiator attacks, he has a chance to deal 150% damage or 75% damage, as determined by skill level.

Name: Duelist
Description: A one-handed sword specialist who excels at counter attacks and is almost impossible to disarm or knock down. Counter Stance generates expertise whenever she counters, and her kit is built around parries and ripostes — parrying an attack, then immediately punishing the attacker with a follow-up strike.
Major 1: Careful Strike – Melee attack with increased accuracy and lower damage  (Duelist)
Major 2: Critical Disarm – Melee attack that disarms on critical (Duelist)
Major 3: Disarmed Disaster – Alpha.  High damage melee attack versus disarmed enemy (Duelist)
Major 4: Disarming Killer – Melee attack with cull against disarmed target (Duelist)
Major 5: Disarming Strike – Melee attack with a chance to disarm target (Duelist)
Major 6: Duel Bond – Melee attack that grants enhanced damage against target if it attacks a different ally before next turn (Duelist)
Major 7: Dueling Strike – Melee attack that compels target to attack duelist and compels duelist to attack target.  Quickens Duelist (Duelist)
Major 8: End the Duel – Disarm target enemy, then attack it based on expertise.  Consumes all expertise (Duelist)
Major 9: Expert Blow, Enhanced – Melee attack that requires expertise (Duelist)
Major 10: Expert Penetration – Melee attack with penetration based off expertise (Duelist)
Major 11: Inevitable Blade – Melee attack.  On miss, gain enhanced accuracy and damage with next melee attack.  Requires expertise (Duelist)
Major 12: Off-Balance Disarm – Melee attack with a chance to disarm target enemy.  Requires flanked (Duelist)
Major 13: Pinpoint Stab – Melee attack with bleed based off pinpoint.  Requires expertise to use (Duelist)
Move 1: Disarming Counter – Duelist has a chance to disarm on counters until next turn (Duelist)
Move 2: Disarming Dominance – Melee attack following disarm against the disarmed (Duelist)
Move 3: Expert Retaliation – Grants untyped retaliation based off expertise (Duelist)
Move 4: Instant Counter – On next counter, instead gain an immediate turn (Duelist)
Move 5: Penetrating Counter – Counter next attack with penetration (Duelist)
Move 6: Shield Disarm – Prevent disarmed enemy from blocking while it is disarmed (Duelist)
Minor 1: Advance on Disarmed – Gain expertise if an enemy is disarmed (Duelist)
Minor 2: Counter Stance – Enhances counter chance, duelist generates expertise when she counters (Duelist)
Minor 3: Disarming Preparation – Increases chance to disarm, requires expertise (Duelist)
Minor 4: Learn from my Mistake – Generate expertise if previous attack was countered (Duelist)
Minor 5: Parry Clang – Next parry distracts parried enemy (Duelist)
Minor 6: Solid Grip – Cannot be disarmed until next turn (Duelist)
Capstone Skill: Disarming Follow Up – The Duelist makes an immediate attack against any enemy that gains the disarmed condition.

Name: Phalanx
Description: A heavy shield bearer who fights best alongside ready allies. Shield Stance generates expertise on every block, and her toolkit includes guaranteed blocks, fortification at the cost of tired, and Phalanx Power, which enhances the damage of all ready allies based on how many are still standing.
Weapon Mech: increased damage per ally ready to act
Major 1: Inevitable Strike – Melee attack that requires expertise that is unblockable, unerring, and unparryable (Phalanx)
Major 2: Overwhelming Strike – Melee attack with overwhelming.  Requires expertise (Phalanx)
Major 3: Phalanx Combo – Melee attack against single enemy with damage enhanced by ready allies (Phalanx)
Major 4: Phalanx Decimation – Melee attack with decimate enhanced by ready allies (Phalanx)
Major 5: Phalanx Onslaught – Number of melee attacks based on number of ready allies (Phalanx)
Major 6: Phalanx Overrun – Melee attack against row with damage enhanced by ready allies (Phalanx)
Major 7: Phalanx Unity – Melee attack that quickens and enhances block chance of all ready allies based on number of ready allies (Phalanx)
Major 8: Puncturing Piercer – Melee attack with penetrate that causes defense weakness on critical (Phalanx)
Major 9: Shield and Strike – Melee attack enhanced by shield following block (Phalanx)
Major 10: Shield Breaker – Melee attack that lowers target’s block chance (Phalanx)
Major 11: Shield Press – Melee attack with stun and disrupt following block (Phalanx)
Major 12: Shield Rush – Melee attack with chance to cause prone based on block chance (Phalanx)
Major 13: Spear and Shield – Melee attack with reduced accuracy and ranged 1 that enhances block chance (Phalanx)

Name: Dervish
Description: A dual-wielding speed specialist whose defining abilities trigger on the second strike of a sequence, becoming more powerful the sooner that second hit follows the first. Major 8: Momentum Onslaught – Melee attack that strikes a number of times based on momentum, alpha (Dervish)

Major 11: Stunning Succession – Dual-wield attack that stuns target on second hit based on dual-wield attack speed. (Dervish)

Name: Fencer
Description: An extraordinarily accurate fighter who specializes in pinpoint attacks that can activate additional conditions at high enough values. Pinpoint Stance generates expertise from hit rolls beyond what is needed to connect, and her kit rewards fighting alone — with Alone Damage and Alone Defense passives that keep her effective as the last fighter standing.

Major 11: Pinpoint Surge – Melee attack that delays all other enemies based on pinpoint value.  Requires expertise (Fencer)
Major 12: Solo Strike – Melee attack with pinpoint requiring alone (Fencer)
Move 1: Blade Flow – Enhance accuracy following parry (Fencer)

Minor 6: Push Response – Delay and flank next parried enemy.  Requires expertise (Fencer)

Name: Lancer
Description: A polearm and spear specialist whose Lancing Blow attacks have a chance to pierce through the primary target and hit the enemy behind them. Retaliation Stance generates expertise through retaliating, and she brings mounted abilities and column-targeting attacks that reward controlling space and threatening multiple rows at once.
Major 1: Dash of Expertise – Melee attack versus a column that requires expertise and quickens the user (Lancer)

Name: Samurai
Description: An initiative-focused dual-wielder who seizes the opening of every battle with maximum aggression. Dodge Stance generates expertise on dodges, and Suicide Stance trades increased offense and counter-chance for the willingness to be struck, generating expertise from taking hits and rewarding an all-or-nothing fighting style.

Major 4: Bushido Blow – Melee attack against enemy.  Enemy attacks Samurai first and damage enhanced by enemy’s damage (Samurai)

Major 7: Bushido Perseverance – Melee attack against enemy.  Each enemy in front row attacks Samurai first and damage enhanced by total enemies’ damage (Samurai)
Major 8: Bushido Provocation – Melee attack against enemy that compels.  Enemy attacks Samurai first and damage enhanced by enemy’s damage (Samurai)
Major 9: Double Bushido Strike – Two melee attack against enemy.  Enemy attacks Samurai first and damage enhanced by enemy’s damage (Samurai)

Major 11: Expert Decimation – Melee attack with decimation based on expertise, prepared (Samurai)
Move 1: Accelerating Taunt – Taunts enemy and quickens self when damaged (Samurai)
Move 2: Amplified Dodge – Enhance dodge and counter chance.  Amplified.  Consumes expertise (Samurai)

Move 6: Evasive Taunt – Taunts enemy and enhances dodge based on expertise (Samurai)

Name: Dreadnaught
Description: An immovable defensive combatant who weaponizes his durability offensively. Unmovable Stance generates expertise from movement effects targeting him, and Advanced Unmovable Stance reflects delays back at enemies, turning every attempt to slow him into a punishment for the attacker.
Weapon Mech: bonus to next damage when quickened

Name: Swashbuckler
Description: A sword-fighting parry expert whose feint abilities compel enemies to attack her, then punish them when she parries the incoming strike. Parry Stance generates expertise from each successful parry, and she chains feints into ripostes, bleeds, penetrating attacks, or mass taunts depending on which feint variant she has prepared.
Major 1: Aorta Slash – Melee attack with penetrate that causes high damage, short term bleed (Swashbuckler)

Major 11: Unerring Stroke – Unerring melee attack that consumes expertise (Swashbuckler)
Move 1: Control Exploit – Delay target and lower dodge and defense based on expertise, consumes all expertise (Swashbuckler)

Capstone Skill: Responsive Parries – Whenever the Swashbuckler parries an attack, she also makes a counter attack.  She has a reduced chance to make counter attacks without parrying though.

Name: Warlord
Description: A commanding leader who translates her own expertise directly into team-wide benefits. Warlord's Stance generates expertise whenever any ally acts, and her Leadership abilities require a minimum expertise level and become more powerful at higher thresholds — quickening all allies, enhancing their damage, or even making their next attack unerring after she misses.
Major 1: Allied Assistance – Warlord makes a melee attack against the target of each ally’s single target attack, consuming expertise with each attack (Warlord)
Major 2: Directing Blow – Melee attack that enhances accuracy of all allies for their next attack based on expertise (Warlord)
Major 3: Disruption Wave – Prepared melee attack versus all enemies that disrupts (Warlord)
Major 4: Evading Blow – Melee attack that enhances dodge of all allies until their next attack based on expertise (Warlord)
Major 5: Example of Expertise – Melee attack that gains increasing number of modifiers based on expertise, including sudden, unblockable, unparryable, unerring, and phasing.  Consumes expertise (Warlord)
Major 6: Expert Instruction – Enhances damage of ally’s next attack based on total expertise (Warlord)
Major 7: Galvanizing Blow – Melee attack that enhances damage of all allies for their next attack based on expertise (Warlord)
Major 8: Powerful Exploit – Melee attack that consumes all expertise to increase damage.  Requires a minimum level of expertise (Warlord)
Major 9: Provocation Blow – Melee attack that provokes target and enhances parry chance until target acts (Warlord)
Major 10: Rallying Blow – Melee attack that quickens all allies based on expertise (Warlord)
Major 11: Rallying Riposte – Prepared ability that counters following parry and quickens all allies (Warlord)
Move 1: Animated Exploit – Consumes all expertise to quicken all allies.  Requires a minimum level of expertise (Warlord)
Move 2: Expediting Taunt – Provoke enemy and quicken allies (Warlord)

Move 4: Invigorating Exploit – Consumes all expertise to enhance damage of all allies.  Requires a minimum level of expertise (Warlord)

Move 6: Target Order – Compel target ally and increase their time by half the time to act (Warlord)
Move 7: War Party – Quickens all allies and enhances damage, requires expertise and preparation (Warlord)

Capstone Skill: Field Commander — Aid abilities used by the unit have enhanced effects and last two turns instead of one.

Name: Bodyguard

Name: Hospitaler

Name: Cavalier

Weapon Mech: damage increases based on time since last action

Name: Myrmidon
Weapon Mech: increased damage while barrier is active

Name: Minstrel
Description: Crescendo-driven buffer who rewards spending small actions on allies to power up larger payoffs. Builds Crescendo stacks through move and minor buffs, then releases them through scaling heal, shield, damage, bleed, and mana abilities. Leans toward chords and positive effects, with strong regeneration support alongside his offensive Crescendo tools.
Capstone Skill: Swelling Enchantments – Until the first action of a unit after a Minstrel enchants them, the enchantment has an increased effect, based on this skill level.

Name: Jester
Description: Chaos-specialist who floods enemies with random afflictions, unpredictable conditions, and misdirected attacks. No formal mechanic — the unpredictability is the design. Best used to overwhelm enemy resistances and create openings for allies, with a capstone that turns his own misfortune into tempo.
Weapon Mech: increased effect and duration of enhancements and weaknesses on first turn
Capstone Skill: Pratfalls – Whenever the Jester becomes prone, he quickens all allies.  Whenever the Jester becomes disarmed, he deals ranged damage to a random enemy.  Both are based on this skill level.

Name: Dirge Singer
Description: The most offensively oriented bard subclass, specializing in life drain, culling, and damage-focused dischords rather than traditional support. He turns the song mechanic toward attrition and erasure — draining life, finishing weakened enemies, and using death itself as an element of his performance. Cacophony abilities reward the whole team's investment in debuffing, making him most dangerous in coordinated groups.
Capstone Skill: Mortal Harvest — Whenever the Dirge Singer kills an enemy with an instant kill effect (culling, ruthless, massive damage, or similar), he restores a percentage of his maximum health and a percentage of his maximum mana.

Name: Balladeer
Description: Earth-focused sustain specialist who stacks litany effects on allies and enemies for escalating pressure. Juggles short-duration stacking conditions that demand constant reapplication — letting them expire collapses the investment. Extended Cuts rewards commitment by progressively raising duration ceilings the more a condition is refreshed.
Weapon Mech: increased power of conditions already present on unit
Capstone Skill: Extended Cuts — Whenever the Balladeer applies a condition that already exists on the target, the maximum duration of that condition is increased. This effect can apply multiple times to the same condition.

Name: Drummer
Description: Elemental support and disruption specialist who grants deity-named favors to allies, healing them and loading them with elemental damage adds. Simultaneously harasses enemies with water and air magic, knockdowns, and delays. Favor of the Drum doubles every favor with a free untyped add, making his allies' attacks substantially more dangerous.
Weapon Mech: minor quicken to all allies on turn
Capstone Skill: Favor of the Drum — Whenever the Drummer grants an elemental damage add to an ally, that ally also receives an additional untyped damage add.

Name: Spy
Description: Stealth-integrated bard who supplements song management with disguises and flanking setups. Each disguise grants role-specific bonuses and can be dramatically discharged for a powerful effect at the cost of the disguise itself. Begins every battle already in disguise, giving immediate access to his full toolkit from the first action.
Capstone Skill: Initial Disguise - The Spy begins battle disguised.  Higher levels of this skill allow more disguise options.

Name: Mountebank
Description: Dark magic manipulator who fights most effectively when enemies cannot see him. Avert, scorn, and hidden each provide a different path to his veiled abilities, which hit harder than normal. Elusive Rhythm turns successful misdirection into tempo, rewarding a Mountebank who keeps multiple avoidance conditions active simultaneously.
Capstone Skill: Elusive Rhythm — Whenever an enemy is prevented from targeting the Mountebank due to a condition, the Mountebank is quickened.

Name: Diva
Description: Conductor-style support who grants allies free attacks through Entourage abilities, drawing enemy aggression onto protected performers. Provokes and taunts redirect incoming damage to allies who are simultaneously shielded, dodging, or enduring. Dedicated Entourage extends every provoke granted, making each protected performer absorb more before attention shifts.
Weapon Mech: increased magic damage but increased mana costs
Capstone Skill: Dedicated Entourage — Whenever the Diva grants a provoke to an ally, that provoke lasts for one additional instance.

Name: Muse
Description: Resurrection-focused support whose most powerful abilities unlock only after an ally returns to life. Epiphany abilities turn each resurrection into a cascade of heals, buffs, mana, and free attacks. His retaliation theme gives him an offensive identity when not raising allies, and Encore ensures he can survive long enough to finish his performance.
Capstone Skill: Encore — When the Muse is killed, he is granted one free resurrection on himself.

Name: Lantern Bearer
Description: Aura-and-light specialist who illuminates the battlefield to empower allies and punish enemies. Manages multiple sustained auras simultaneously while spreading illuminate to lock enemies out of hidden and set up targeted light abilities. Constant Light makes him a hard counter to all stealth-based enemy strategies, fundamentally reshaping how battles play out at Tier 25.
Capstone Skill: Constant Light – No units can gain hidden in battle.

Name: Conjurer
Description: A summoner who fights in concert with her conjured allies, using their mana reserves to amplify her own attacks. She manifests spectral weapons for any ally and directs her companion with precision, growing stronger the more she and her creature act as one.
Capstone Skill: Death Throes – When a companion of the Conjurer would die, it makes one last attack.

Name: Occultist
Description: A Thanatos-leaning controller who wraps herself and allies in retaliatory spirits, punishing enemies for every strike they land. She pairs water and air magic for freeze and delay with a cross-alignment toolkit that rewards deliberate dips into Eros.
Capstone Skill: Initial Retaliation – The Occultist deals additional damage the first-time retaliation triggers each time she gains it.

Name: Shaman
Description: A support specialist who prepares a battery of Attendant abilities and waits for her companion to critical — triggering all of them at once in a cascade of healing, damage, and quickening. The longer she waits, the more devastating the payoff.
Capstone Skill: Critical Attendance – Whenever the Shaman scores a critical hit, her companion has an increased chance to critical during its turn.

Name: Medium
Description: A balanced-alignment caster who draws equal power from both dark and light, strongest when she resists pushing to either extreme. Her Harmony abilities detonate from center for massive effect, then push her off balance — and she spends the next turns clawing her way back.
Capstone Skill: Dualistic Power – Whenever the Medium increases one elemental power or resistance, she increases the opposed power by a percentage of that amount.

Name: Animist
Description: A spiritual warrior who infuses her companion with procs before it acts and rides a summoned Spirit Beast into mounted combat. She synchronizes her actions with her creature through a shared spiritual bond, raising fallen companions and granting her allies the will to survive past death.
Weapon Mech: bonus damage while companion is alive
Capstone Skill: Animated Persistence – Animation abilities from the Animist have a chance not to be consumed when they trigger.

Name: Spiritualist
Description: A desperation specialist whose entire toolkit unlocks at low health, becoming most powerful precisely when she should be most vulnerable. Her transformation locks in that endangered power permanently, turning near-death into a lasting combat state.
Weapon Mech: endangered damage, bonus when both user and target are endangered
Capstone Skill: Endangered Awakening – Whenever the Spiritualist becomes endangered, she quickens and gains enhanced magic power with her next turn.

Name: Astrologer
Description: A critical-hit amplifier who builds toward celestial thresholds across multiple turns, generating mana, quickening herself, and purging afflictions with each enemy she crits. She wields the full elemental spectrum through a stellar lens, with her lucky damage toolkit turning probability itself into a weapon.
Weapon Mech: increased damage for each enemy damaged during turn
Capstone Skill: Sea of Stars – Whenever the Astrologer scores enough critical hits, she triggers a light magic attack against all enemies.

Name: Vizier
Description: A selfish corruptor who damages her own allies to fuel her offensive power, scaling with the total corruption she spreads across the battlefield. She transforms her own self-inflicted corruption into a permanent power state, and turns enemy deaths into mana through Dark Harvest.
Capstone Skill: Dark Harvest – Whenever a unit with corruption on it dies, the Vizier restores mana based on the level of corruption.

Name: Alienist
Description: A sanity-sacrificing chaos mage who deliberately accumulates illusory damage on herself to unlock her most powerful abilities. She cannot be killed by her own madness — but when it expires, it becomes very real, making resource management a matter of survival.
Capstone Skill: Life of Insanity – The Alienist cannot die from illusory damage, but when illusory damage expires, it is converted into real damage based on the level of this passive.

Name: Pact Master
Description: A high-commitment alignment specialist who signs powerful ongoing Pacts, each granting two bonuses at the cost of one persistent drawback. She thrives at the extremes of the alignment scale, and her Lifebond with her companion means their fates are literally intertwined — she cannot fall while it stands.
Weapon Mech: intrinsic heal siphon and pain link with companion
Capstone Skill: Lifebond – Whenever the Pact Master would be dealt lethal damage while she has a companion, she survives with one health and all overflow damage is dealt to her companion.

Name: Acolyte
Description: Quick and affordable support built around lucky manipulation and regeneration. Generates divinity through hexes, purges, and blessings, then spends it on Benedictions — powerful single-target heals enhanced by current divinity, with overheal effects that range from possession to damage to speed depending on the type used.
Capstone Skill: Assisted Overheals – Overheals from the Acolyte include a percentage of all health restored, based on the level of this skill.

Name: Healer
Description: Pure restoration specialist with the mana economy to sustain heavy healing across a long battle. His cures carry addenda that scale with heal value, turning strong heals into purges, quickens, or damage adds. A Life Domain running on overheal generation lets him convert aggressive healing directly into sustained divinity.

Name: Disciple
Description: Affliction-resistant purge specialist who turns enemy pressure into elemental retaliation. Elemental purges double as generators and resistance enhancers scaled to current divinity, and a Protection Domain that rewards affliction resistance creates a feedback loop where enemy affliction pressure fuels his own power.
Capstone Skill: Reactive Resistance – The Disciple gains elemental resistance based on the last element that damaged him.

Name: Priest
Description: Magically aggressive Cleric who layers blessings onto allies while maintaining his own damage shield as an offensive weapon. The Lattice ability line scales with and consumes his shield for light damage and control, Lattice Reflection punishes enemies who target it, and a Sun Domain that generates from light abilities rewards sustained Celestial offense.

Name: Combat Medic
Description: Frontline healer built for endangered allies and active combat. Vitality heals grant temporary bonuses that persist until the target takes damage, and a War Domain that generates from any ally's critical hits rewards pairing him with damage-heavy parties. Perilous Divinity marks low-health targets for stronger healing while generating divinity.
Capstone Skill: Conserve Vitality - The Combat Medic has a chance to keep vitality buffs when damaged based on this passive.

Name: Exorcist
Description: Light-magic specialist with exclusive access to intangible enemies and strong mana drain. Most abilities gain additional effects against incorporeal targets, and an Exorcism Domain that generates divinity proportional to total enemy mana spent rewards fighting caster-heavy encounters where the domain becomes a powerful self-sustaining engine.
Capstone Skill: Exorcism – Attacks against intangible enemies have a chance to automatically kill them based on their low health and mana.

Name: Preacher
Description: Sleep-focused controller who worships the sleeping god and grows in power while the world slumbers. Incapacitated allies feed Rest Domain divinity generation even without the Preacher acting, turning sleep from a liability into a resource. Turns ally afflictions into advantages and punishes sleeping enemies with a focused suite of nightmare attacks.
Weapon Mech: increased incapacitate potency and landing chance

Name: Zealot
Description: High-speed melee Cleric who conducts the entire party's tempo through quickening. Ascension abilities require but do not spend full divinity, creating a maintain-and-hold pattern rather than the typical spend-and-rebuild cycle. A mastery class at Tier 19 — maximizing output requires deep awareness of quicken tolerance, Ascension timing, and Fervor Domain generation simultaneously.
Weapon Mech: increased damage and speed when alone

Name: Plague Doctor
Description: Self-infecting contagion spreader who carries disease deliberately to fuel his domain. Plague Domain generates divinity for each affliction successfully transferred from the Plague Doctor to an enemy, rewarding stacking afflictions on himself and building around affliction resistance to survive the risk. One of the most dangerous and mechanically demanding Cleric subclasses.
Capstone Skill: Plague Bearer - The Plague Doctor begins battle with contagion that has a chance to spread afflictions to enemies instead.

Name: Oracle
Description: Capstone Cleric whose Furtherance abilities scale with divinity gained during the current turn rather than total on hand. Front-loading a turn with support actions directly amplifies his payoff. A Prophecy Domain that generates divinity when countdowns fire — scaled to their duration — rewards patience and long-term planning over reactive play.
Weapon Mech: increased countdown duration, attacks increase countdown power

Name: Buccaneer
Capstone Skill: Enhanced Potential – Whenever the Buccaneer uses an ability that is based on the value of a damage affliction, the value is considered greater, based on this skill level.

Name: Executioner
Weapon Mech: extra damage against lowest health enemy
Capstone Skill: Critical Execution – The Executioner deals increased critical damage if the target has the lowest health.

Name: Gravedigger
Capstone Skill: Burial Proc – The modified skill has a chance to afflict the target with burial.

Name: Hangman
Weapon Mech: increased damage based on tired duration on target

Name: Harbinger
Weapon Mech: extra damage to next ally attacking same target
Capstone Skill: Constant Moon – Moon automatically appears in battle, determined by game calendar, at a lesser power.

Name: Sin Eater
Weapon Mech: increased damage after purging or disenchanting
Capstone Skill: Sinful Vapors - The Sin Eater gains mana whenever any affliction is purged.

Name: Sandman
Weapon Mech: attacks have chance to be insidious
Capstone Skill: Nightmare Manifest – Whenever incapacitated is removed from the Sandman, he deals illusory damage to all enemies based on the period he was incapacitated.

Name: Whisperer
Weapon Mech: increased damage against more enemies present
Capstone Skill: Whispering Maladies - The Whisperer has improved affliction power based on total number of enemies.

Name: Telepath
Description: The entry point for deep influence play. The Telepath specializes in illusory damage and disruption, with heightened abilities that let her translate influence investment into cascading multi-cast effects. She is subtle and methodical, chipping away at enemy defenses before they can act.
Weapon Mech: dodge and reflection bonus after attacking
Capstone Skill: Greater Heights – Heightened abilities cost less mana for each extra cast.

Name: Kinetic
Description: A spread-oriented damage dealer who turns punishment into power. Her kinetic abilities charge between turns based on physical damage she absorbs, making her uniquely dangerous when enemies focus on her. She favors broad pressure and area control over single-target dominance.
Weapon Mech: ranged damage based on magic power
Capstone Skill: Kinetic Control – The Kinetic gains kinetic bonuses from own physical damage.

Name: Amnesiac
Description: A denial specialist who erodes the enemy's ability to function. She burns through mana, forces enemies into basic attacks, and makes them forget what they were doing. She also carries an unexpected compassionate edge, helping allies forget their wounds.
Weapon Mech: procs avert on target when attacking
Capstone Skill: Brainburning Strikes – Whenever the Amnesiac attacks an enemy with mana burn, she triggers that affliction on the target.

Name: Hypnotist
Description: A pattern-weaver who controls the entire battlefield through sustained channeled effects. She locks enemies into states of blindness, stun, or vulnerability for as long as she can keep her focus. Patient and methodical, she rewards players who plan their turns carefully.
Capstone Skill: Lingering Patterns - Patterns remain active for a period after channeling starts.

Name: Diviner
Description: An information broker and countdown specialist who fights the future rather than the present. Her divinations expose enemy weaknesses and upcoming actions, letting the whole party respond intelligently, while her countdown abilities punish enemies for the passage of time itself.
Capstone Skill: Double Divination – The Diviner can maintain two divination effects at a time.

Name: Haunted
Description: A ghost-touched subclass who exploits enemies at their weakest — specifically when their mana runs dry. She drains, haunts, and possesses with impunity against vulnerable targets, and can become intangible herself to frighten and evade. Death Knell makes her the safest handler of deep influence.
Capstone Skill: Haunted Spells - Spells have increased effect on low mana targets.

Name: Mastermind
Description: The party coordinator. Rather than dominating enemies directly, she possesses allies to direct them more efficiently and uses total influence to synchronize team timing. She rewards players who understand their whole roster and rewards smart sequencing over raw power.

Name: Mindbleeder
Description: A high-risk, high-reward glass cannon who bleeds the mind as much as the body. She deals devastating illusory damage that grows stronger the closer she is to death. Her own abilities hurt her, but the connection flows both ways — and she intends to make that cost worth it.
Weapon Mech: additional damage based on illusory damage on target
Capstone Skill: Morbid Imagination – The Mindbleeder has increased illusory power the closer she is to death, based on the level of this skill.

Name: Chronomancer
Description: A spread-influence subclass who bends time itself to delay, rush, and disorient the battlefield. She punishes fast enemies, accelerates allies, and becomes more efficient the more she leans into her hasted or slowed states. Supreme Chronomancy is one of the most powerful single abilities in the psychic tree.
Capstone Skill: Personal Time – The Chronomancer benefits when either slowed or hasted, with enchantments lasting longer while slower and afflictions fading quicker when hasted.

Name: Puppet Master
Description: The pinnacle of possession mastery. She owns enemies outright, bends their will across multiple turns, and profits from every attack they make under her control. Her capstone, Broken Will, ensures that no enemy is ultimately beyond her reach.
Capstone Skill: Broken Will – The Psychic lowers possession resistance and ignore possession by a percentage based on this skill level.

Name: Abjurer
Capstone Skill: Double Defense Procs – Whenever a defense proc or runes triggers on the unit, it has a chance to trigger twice.

Name: Symbolist
Weapon Mech: next attack deals extra fire damage

Name: Cabalist
Capstone Skill: Know Your Master – Companions will not attack the Cabalist, and have a chance not to attack other party members.

Name: Disenchanter
Weapon Mech: chance to proc disenchant on attack

Name: Sage
Capstone Skill: Prismatic Magic – The Sage has a chance to create a random prism when this proc triggers.

Name: Glyphic
Weapon Mech: critical multiplier applies to damage adds on critical
Capstone Skill: Double Attack Procs – Whenever an attack proc or rune triggers on the unit, it has a chance to trigger twice.

Name: Cryptic
Weapon Mech: deals portion of countdown damage present on target
Capstone Skill: Remnants of Fate - Whenever a countdown triggers, the Cryptic gains mana.

Name: Sorcerer
Weapon Mech: damage scales with total mana used
Capstone Skill: Preemptive Preparation – The Sorcerer begins battle with one random ability prepared.

Name: Cultist
Description: A team-oriented controller who drains stats from maledicted enemies and redistributes them to allies. She weaponizes possession and hexes for direct control while her Malign drain suite debilitates entire maledicted groups — and Share in Consumption ensures no drain benefit passes through her hands without leaving something behind.
Capstone Skill: Share in Consumption – Whenever a drain ability benefits an ally, the Cultist gets a portion of the effect based on this skill level.

Name: Warlock
Description: An air-element Witch who turns malediction into a positional weapon. Her whirlwind abilities use a maledicted enemy as an anchor, striking all adjacent foes instead — rewarding grid awareness and central positioning. Bloodlust amplifies her storm attacks while Conductivity makes the entire maledicted field a lightning rod.
Capstone Skill: Whirlwind Targeting – The modified skill has a chance to target all enemies adjacent to the original target.

Name: Effigist
Description: The most aggressive Witch subclass, stacking damage afflictions on targets to fuel piercing effigy attacks that cut through resistance. Flammability turns every fire hit into compounding bleeds, and Personal Effigy rewards taking damage herself — making her a high-risk attacker who burns hotter the more punishment she absorbs.
Capstone Skill: Personal Effigy – The Effigist gains increased magic damage for each damage affliction present on her.

Name: Dustbringer
Description: A methodical earth-element controller who applies permanent unending afflictions that reserve her mana until enemies die or are purged. She trades mana flexibility for devastating long-term debilitation, and Mana From Dust recycles her investment when corruption finishes the job.
Weapon Mech: bonus damage based on corruption on target
Capstone Skill: Mana From Dust - Whenever the Dustbringer kills an enemy with corruption, she recovers mana based on that corruption.

Name: Crone
Description: A water-element specialist who deals increased damage and effects in inverse proportion to enemy speed — making her strongest against the foes she has already slowed. Chill to Frost converts redundant slows into hard incapacitation, and Inspiring Misfortune makes her one of the strongest mana generators in the entire Witch family.
Weapon Mech: bonus damage based on target's slow value
Capstone Skill: Chill to Frost - Whenever an enemy would be slowed enemy is slowed again, it is instead incapacitated.

Name: Hedgemage
Description: A chaotic generalist who trades reliability for volume, deploying cheap bewitch afflictions against maledicted enemies at reduced action cost. Agnostic Afflictions removes elemental opposition penalties on vulnerability and exposure, letting her stack conditions freely regardless of enemy resistances — chaos as a feature, not a flaw.
Weapon Mech: last action each turn has improved magic power
Capstone Skill: Agnostic Afflictions – The Hedgemage ignores the opposing element penalty for vulnerability and exposure effects she applies. These effects retain full value even against resistances that would normally reduce them, as if the element were neutral.

Name: Mambo
Description: A light-element support Witch who harvests fetishes from fallen enemies and deploys them as stat-scaling ally buffs. She transfers afflictions from allies to enemies, drains life, and accumulates mana through Fetish Bag by holding fetishes in reserve — balancing the tension between deploying her toolkit and sustaining herself.
Weapon Mech: improved heal and purge per affliction on ally
Capstone Skill: Fetish Bag – The Witch Doctor gains increased mana generation for each fetish currently held and not yet deployed. The bonus scales with the number of undeployed fetishes.

Name: Bokor
Description: A dark necromancer who builds zombie companions from killed and afflicted enemies, using Juju Curse to turn her entire malediction toolkit into a zombie pipeline. Corpse Pile makes each death — enemy or companion — strengthen her current zombie, turning attrition into escalating companion power.
Weapon Mech: damage dealt heals companion by small percentage
Capstone Skill: Corpse Pile – Whenever another companion would be generated or would die, the Bokor's current zombie companion restores health and gains increased maximum health.

Name: Hag
Description: A corruption and bleed specialist who wraps her worst afflictions in criterion shells that resist purging until they deal their full damage. Expiration Surge turns every naturally expiring condition into mana, rewarding patience and long-duration stacking — Plague Cauldron's exponential corruption release is her most catastrophic payoff for waiting.
Weapon Mech: increased affliction power per affliction on self
Capstone Skill: Expiration Surge – Whenever any affliction on any enemy expires naturally, the Hag generates mana. Criteria that complete their damage threshold generate a larger mana bonus.

Name: Malefax
Description: The apex Witch, combining covenants, curses, and mass malediction into a comprehensive affliction dominance platform. She channels malediction across entire enemy groups with Malefaction Chant, unifies damage through Sympathy, and elevates her whole party's affliction pressure through Cursed Amplification — the Witch's toolkit at its most absolute.
Capstone Skill: Cursed Amplification – Increases the potency and power of all afflictions used against cursed enemies. This applies to afflictions used by any ally, not just the Malefax.

Name: Elementalist
Description: All-elements generalist with companion support and momentum-driven efficiency. She cycles through every element in sequence to build stacking cast speed and mana bonuses, summons earth and water elementals, and infuses allies with elemental damage adds — the most versatile and accessible wizard subclass.
Capstone Skill: Elemental Momentum — Each time the Elementalist uses an ability with a different element than the previous elemental ability, she gains a stacking bonus to cast speed and reduced mana cost. The stack resets to zero when she repeats an element from her current set.

Name: Necromancer
Description: Dark magic specialist who turns death itself into a resource. She raises skeletal companions, scales her storm damage to the body count, and runs a suite of prepared abilities that trigger automatically when enemies fall — rewarding her for battles where allies are doing the killing as much as her own.
Capstone Skill: Kill Steal — The Necromancer's kill skills have a chance to activate when allied units kill enemies.

Name: Hydromancer
Description: Control-focused water specialist with the deepest incapacitation toolkit in the class. She freezes, slows, and delays entire battlefields, with her most powerful conflux ability scaling both the number of targets incapacitated and how hard they are to wake based on how many elements she has charged.
Capstone Skill: Water Mastery – Water spells cost less mana and cast quicker.

Name: Geomancer
Description: Defensive earth specialist who protects allies while grinding down enemy defenses. She builds damage shields, roots enemies in place, and applies layered weaknesses — her conflux abilities uniquely favor the whole party by granting elemental retaliations and stacking debuffs across every stat.
Capstone Skill: Earth Mastery – Earth spells cost less mana and cast quicker.

Name: Aeromancer
Description: High-variance air specialist built around storm damage and stun pressure. She thrives on randomness — chaining lightning across the grid, forking attacks into splits, and stacking storm hits to overwhelm enemies — with the highest individual damage ceiling in the class when lucky damage and maximum damage align.
Capstone Skill: Air Mastery – Air spells cost less mana and cast quicker.

Name: Pyromancer
Description: Area fire specialist who hits everyone, repeatedly. She applies countdowns, causes wounds, and commits fully to upfront mana costs for abilities that pay off over multiple ticks — Catastrophe and Conflux Meteor reward planning several turns ahead and punish enemies who cannot interrupt her.
Capstone Skill: Fire Mastery – Fire spells cost less mana and cast quicker.

Name: Arcanist
Description: Anti-attunement specialist who grows stronger the more completely she clears her elemental slate. She is the only wizard whose peak performance comes after spending conflux rather than before it, with her most powerful abilities gating behind having no attunements and her conflux damage rewarding precise elemental power investment over breadth.
Capstone Skill: Arcane Conversion – When the modified skill is triggered, the damage type has a chance to be converted to arcane.

Name: Solomancer
Description: Light magic specialist with hex, justice, and a unique mana economy identity. She wants enemies casting expensive spells so her Mana Disparity bonus peaks, making her the only wizard who benefits from enemy casters. Her full-conflux Conflux Enchantment can grant the entire party six simultaneous buffs scaled to her elemental investment.
Capstone Skill: Mana Disparity — Increases magic power based on the difference between the target's current mana and the Solomancer's current mana. Checked before the ability's mana cost is spent.

Name: Incanter
Description: Reactive counterspell specialist who punishes enemy spellcasting while sustaining channeled damage. She runs a suite of prepared counterspells that can chain indefinitely, drains mana from enemies, and uses Conflux Channeling to chain successive elemental damage sequences — the only wizard subclass that gets stronger the more the enemy commits to magic.
Capstone Skill: Reflected Counterspell — Prepared ability that counters an enemy spell and deals magic damage to the caster and random enemies based on the countered spell's mana cost.

Name: Thaumaturge
Description: Pinnacle attunement-breadth specialist who rewards deliberate, expensive play. She wants all six elements charged simultaneously, spends them through Supreme abilities that scale with attunement count, and uses her previous turn's mana expenditure to amplify the next — the most technically demanding wizard subclass and the one with the highest ceiling.
Capstone Skill: Arcane Expenditure — Enhances the magic power of all abilities used on the next turn based on total mana spent on the current turn.
